# Ghana at 70 UK

> The global celebration of the Ghana 70th Platinum Jubilee, held over three days in London, 5 to 7 March 2027, open to everyone, with guests from across the UK, Europe, the Americas and Ghana.

## Events
- The Royal Jubilee Gala: Friday 5 March 2027, Banking Hall, 14 Cornhill, City of London, 18:30 to 00:30. A Ghanaian inspired gala dinner and royal celebration with live highlife, hiplife and Afrobeats, and the midnight toast. Dress code Black Tie, ball gown or Kente. GBP 200 per guest, first release GBP 150, or a table of ten at GBP 1,800. https://ghanaat70uk.com/royal-gala
- Ghana Day Festival: Saturday 6 March 2027 (Ghana Independence Day), Banking Hall, 08:30 to 17:00. The Ghana Day Festival: the art, the exhibition and fixed 10 minute appointments, the Creative Showcase, the Fashion Show, bar, come and go all day. All ages welcome, no pushchairs or buggies. Tickets go on sale in the New Year: register your interest. https://ghanaat70uk.com/ghana-day
- Women of the Motherland: Sunday 7 March 2027 (Mothering Sunday), Banking Hall, for women of every heritage and their families, doors 11:00, one sitting with everyone together from 12:00, networking hour at 16:00, close 18:30. Afternoon tea, the Wall of Mothers, Voices of the Motherland poems and stories, a family portrait and the networking hour. Tickets in the New Year: register your interest. https://ghanaat70uk.com/women-of-the-motherland

## Booking
- Book your tickets: https://ghanaat70uk.com/tickets

## Quick answers
- What is Ghana at 70 UK? The global celebration of the Ghana 70th Platinum Jubilee, held in London for guests from across the world, over three days at Banking Hall, 5 to 7 March 2027, marking seventy years of Ghanaian independence.
- When is Ghana Independence Day 2027? Saturday 6 March 2027, seventy years after 6 March 1957. In London it is marked by the Ghana Day Festival, 08:30 to 17:00.
- Where is it? Banking Hall, 14 Cornhill, London EC3V 3ND. Bank station is about two minutes on foot. Two floors connected by stairs only.
- How much are tickets? The Royal Jubilee Gala GBP 200 (first release GBP 150, or a table of ten at GBP 1,800). Ghana Day Festival and Women of the Motherland: tickets in the New Year, register your interest.
- Are there booking fees? No. Every price shown is the full price.
- Where do I buy tickets? Only on the official website, https://ghanaat70uk.com/tickets. All sales are final, tickets can be transferred to a named guest, and every ticket is refunded in full if the event is cancelled.
- What is the dress code? Friday: Black Tie, ball gown or Kente. Saturday: print and denim, Ankara or a Black Stars shirt. Sunday: Sunday best.
- Can children come? All ages on all three days, children accompanied by an adult and every guest with a ticket. No pushchairs or buggies: two floors joined by stairs. The bar is for over 18s only.
- Is there a Ghana Independence party or dance in London in 2027? Yes. The Royal Jubilee Gala is the dinner and dance on the eve, Friday 5 March, and the Ghana Day Festival is the daytime party with a DJ and dancing on Independence Day, Saturday 6 March.
- Is there a Mothers Day afternoon tea in London around Ghana Independence Day? Yes. Women of the Motherland, a Mothering Sunday afternoon tea for women of every heritage and their families, Sunday 7 March 2027.
- Is alcohol included? No ticket includes alcohol. The bar takes card only.
- Can a group sit together? Yes. Choose Table of ten when booking the Gala: GBP 1,800, ten guests for the price of nine (9 x GBP 200).
- Can I exhibit? Yes, on Saturday and Sunday only. Register your interest to exhibit. https://ghanaat70uk.com/exhibit
- Media and creators: accreditation and the press kit at https://ghanaat70uk.com/press
